thm r38_joint_original_spine:
    ? forall x0 R,radius R+,sample R:
        sample=x0+radius/2
        =>:
            sample!=x0
            abs(sample-x0)<radius
    0<radius/2
    sample=x0+radius/2>x0
    sample!=x0
    sample-x0=radius/2
    sample-x0>0
    0<=sample-x0
    abs(sample-x0)=sample-x0=radius/2
    radius/2<radius
